video.title: AI欧腐《被卖给了暗恋多年的死对头/Sold to the Rival I Secretly Loved》
video.desc:
Jesse was once a talented pro boxer — until a fixed fight cost him his entire career. Now he’s forced to fight in underground matches to pay for his young daughter Mia’s life-saving surgery. The last man he ever wants to see again is Grant: his cocky, self-proclaimed straight high school nemesis, who’s hated him for years, convinced Jesse stole his girlfriend back in school. But Grant holds all the cards now. He offers Jesse a well-paid contract as his personal bodyguard — with intimate, non-negotiable conditions attached. With Mia’s life on the line, Jesse has no choice but to sign. Caught between his long-hidden secret crush and Grant’s simmering resentment, he’s pulled into a dangerous game of hate and desire, with stakes higher than any fight he’s ever stepped into.
Jesse 曾是一名天赋出众的职业拳手——直到一场假拳毁掉了他的整个职业生涯。如今，为了给年幼的女儿 Mia 筹钱做救命手术，他只能在地下拳赛上拼命。
他这辈子最不想再见到的人，就是 Grant：那个狂妄、自称直男的高中死对头。Grant 恨了他好多年，始终认定当年是 Jesse 抢走了自己的女朋友。
可现在，所有筹码都攥在 Grant 手里。他开出一份高薪合同，聘 Jesse 做自己的私人保镖——附带的，是一些私密到不容商量的条件。女儿的命悬在那里，Jesse 别无选择，只能签字。
一边是藏了多年的暗恋，一边是 Grant 积压已久的怨恨——Jesse 被拖进了一场恨意与欲望交织的危险游戏，赌注比他打过的任何一场拳都要高。
